name: Single Cell Communication
description: Network connectivity partner supporting TheHubVisionary's cloud, hosting, and network setup services.

name: Add your hardware supplier
description: Wherever you source replacement parts and equipment — screens, keyboards, RAM, SSDs, routers, cameras. Replace this with your actual supplier's name via the admin panel (Partners tab) once you're ready to credit them.

name: Add your payments partner
description: Your M-Pesa till/paybill provider or payment gateway, if you'd like to credit them here.

name: Add your cloud/software partner
description: A Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 reseller, or a software licensing partner you work with.

name: Add your SMS gateway provider
description: The bulk SMS gateway behind your Bulk SMS Services offering (e.g. Africa's Talking, Host Pinnacle).

name: Add your hosting/domains partner
description: Where you register domains and host client websites, if you'd like to credit them here.
